report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the checkout error-rate/latency alert and no downstream evidence exists, so no bounded root-cause candidate is supported. Handing off for evidence covering the alert window and downstream services.

Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiters metrics for downstream services, not only gateway
Logs/traces from downstream services covering the alert window
